text: A title card reads, "the Mango Open Movie project." Next, huge rocket thruster cones loom above a massive industrial launch complex shrouded in mist.

text: One by one, the thrusters ignite, blasting blazing white fire downwards, lighting up the cityscape as the rocket prepares for launch.

text: A man with dreadlocks works at a laboratory console. Later, a pink holographic brain floats.
On a black screen, silver text reads, "TEARS OF STEEL." Next, a futuristic city unfolds with traditional buildings beneath a floating mechanical craft.
A sniper in a bell tower aims at a ship. Below him, a newspaper covering Thom's face reads, 'ROBOTICIST CREATES KILLER ROBOTS'.
Through the sniper’s scope, the floating vessel drifts closer. It is cluttered with spotlights, satellites, and various mechanical gear.
Thom pulls the newspaper from his face and looks up at the ceiling. The sniper remains in the background, staring into the scope.
The floating vessel hovers directly over the city roofs, its bright spotlights shining. The sniper tracks the ship through his rifle scope, holding his position.
note: Creo que deberia describir que en esa escena, esa nave flotante fue atacada por unos robots o drones antes de caer a los techos de las casas/edificios. Y por ello la aeronave fue derribada

text: Thom lies on his back with his eyes closed, his hand resting on his chest. Then, he sits up and rubs his face, looking weary.
Thom looks away.
The sniper continues to peer through the rifle scope. Nearby, an older man with white hair steps through a doorway, holding onto a rope.
The man steps off a balcony and swings across the cavernous room, dangling from the rope in front of a giant pipe organ.
The white-haired man swings past a thick rope in the center of the frame, his back to the camera as he nears the machinery.
The white-haired man stands in a doorway, observing the room. He looks to his left, his expression serious, before he turns away slightly.
note: Falto agregar que cuando ingreso en el cuarto, habia una mujer. No se si una soldado a su derecha viendo como este ingresaba al cuarto.

text: The white-haired man walks towards a desk in the overgrown room. He approaches Thom, who remains seated and looks toward him.
note: Un poco mas de descripción, como que al salir del cuarto, se encuentra una calle con vegetación, y la nave que esta por despegar

text: The sniper holds Thom.
Thom stands on a bridge, arms outstretched as holographic squares envelop his body.
The sniper points at Celia, standing beside them.

text: The white-haired man stands on the bridge with Celia and the sniper, who places a hand on his back as holographic squares float around them.
The translucent boxes pulse around his torso, expanding and contracting as Thom remains standing, looking down toward his own waist in the center frame.
note: Tambien indicar que esos cuadros holográficos, se posaron sobre el señor de cabello blanco, y paso a ser un hombre joven, o al menos eso se ve.

text: Thom walks along a stone bridge in Amsterdam. He wears a patterned jacket with yellow accents, passing a yellow traffic sign marked with an F.
Thom stops on the bridge and faces the towering, complex mechanical suit. The machine looms over him, its metallic components intricate and exposed.
A close-up of a metallic, mechanical robot face with glowing circular eyes. Cut to Celia, then Thom, both looking toward the robot with concern.
Thom looks away.
The sun sets behind architectural domes and cranes in Amsterdam. Through a camera lens, a mechanical suit jumps between the rooftop gables of old houses.
note: Mas que un traje mecánico, es un robot sobre el techo

text: The sniper looks away.
A quick glitch flashes back to the control room, then Thom watches Celia's metallic hand.
Celia glares at Thom.
Celia grabs Thom's mouth.
Thom presses the playback button with his palm.
